description: This file defines extension methods for configuring grain placement strategies and directors within the Orleans host builder. It provides methods for adding placement directors with different service lifetime options, facilitating dependency injection setup for Orleans silo configuration.

classes.name: PlacementStrategyExtensions
classes.description: Provides static extension methods to configure placement strategies and directors for Orleans hosting.

methods.name: AddPlacementDirector<TStrategy, TDirector>
methods.description: Configures the builder to include a specified placement director for a given placement strategy.

methods.name: AddPlacementDirector<TStrategy>
methods.description: Adds a placement director for a specific strategy via a creation delegate.

methods.name: AddPlacementDirector<TStrategy, TDirector> (with ServiceLifetime)
methods.description: Registers a placement director with a specified lifetime.

methods.name: AddPlacementDirector<TStrategy> (with delegate and ServiceLifetime)
methods.description: Adds a placement director via delegate with specified lifetime.
